context:
Implementation merged in PR #2880: head 7ab1af16086a5ba0145e667228c04a5ab5a13b96, merge commit e9cdaf3ac288cf69658770b62cae2cc3a02be668. The additive `refresh_session` hook re-applies each arm's ClickHouse adapter session and settings pack before each power round. Evidence in runs/harness-session-reapply-20261010/: 30/30 timed executions carried the configured session; cell B (seed 43, 15 rounds, Q13-only) passed A/A with G 0.9782 and no answer mismatches; harness suite 97 passed; full fast suite 37,076 passed, 26 skipped. `gh pr checks 2880 --required` reports core, docs, explorer, landing, oracle-review, results-data, and tooling all pass.

Acceptance is blocked on environment validity. The cell-B `summary.md` records host macOS-27.0.1, Mocker 0.7.2, and Apple Container CLI 1.1.0. `docs/operations/uat-framework.md:301` documents Mocker validation on macOS 26 only. The observed cell is therefore not supported-platform calibration evidence under current documentation. Rerun the Q13 A/A on Linux/Docker or a documented, validated Apple Container path before finishing. The full 22-query post-fix verdict cell remains with item 25; it is not an F1 acceptance item.

Revalidated 2026-11-11: still required and still blocked; the text is accurate. PR #2880 is merged (e9cdaf3ac2); the sole open acceptance item is supported-host evidence (Q13 A/A on Linux/Docker or a validated Apple Container/Mocker path). Owner decision 2026-11-11 (choice dialog): supported host for the ClickHouse A/A and probe reruns: validate and document the macOS 27 Mocker path (with an A/A noise check) on the maintainer Mac, then run under make heavy-run.

2026-11-12: Host: macOS 27.0.1, mocker 0.7.2, container CLI 1.1.0, ClickHouse 25.8.33.6, 5.25 GiB guest limit (memory.max 5637144576, oom_kill 0); evidence under ~/Developer/benchmark_runs/tuning-measure-20261112/. TPC-H SF1 A/A passed on the macOS 27 Mocker path: 3 identical notuning arms, 22 queries, 9 rounds, seed 42; B/A G 1.0335 [0.9276, 1.1034], C/A G 1.0213 [0.9287, 1.0997]; Q13 = 42 rows in all 27 timed executions; noise high (median per-query CI half-width 0.268, host load 8.6-12). New root cause found: clickhouse_driver disconnects on any query error, so after Q21 fails at 5.25 GiB later queries ran under bare server defaults (Q13 42->41); PR #2880's per-round refresh_session does not cover it. Fix (re-apply session after any failed query, tests) committed locally as 0b537483db on branch docs/clickhouse-mocker-macos27-runbook; PR pending. description: Item-26 evidence (runs/clickhouse-q3-q5-probe-20261008/findings-26.md section 5): ClickHouse server session SETs are applied once per arm connection at load; timed rounds can run under bare server defaults after the session is lost (Run 1: 180/180 timed executions with 2-setting bare session vs 20/20 configured warmups). The join_use_nulls flip moved Q13 42<->41 deterministically and solely blocked A/A calibration. Arm comparisons stay apples-to-apples but absolute parity with shipped runs breaks. Change: re-apply the adapter session per round (or attach settings per query, or pin session_id); add a test asserting timed executions carry the configured session. ClickHouse verdicts (benefit rule, per-query settings, session pack) should prefer post-fix cells.
